## About
Piedmont Social House sits in downtown Steele Creek, in the town of Ayrsley in Southwest Charlotte. We set out to build a place where friends, family and neighbors could connect over good food, drinks and games. Our purpose is simple: to strengthen the bonds of our community.
Our full-service restaurant serves Southern inspired cuisine with a big selection of craft beer and cocktails. Beyond the dining room, our industrial-style social house has bowling lanes, billiards, ping pong, darts, shuffleboard and cornhole, plus party and meeting spaces and a patio where you can catch live music.
We're just minutes from Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, Pineville and Lake Wylie. Parking is free, and shops and entertainment are within walking distance. Guests rate us 4.4 from 3431 Google reviews. Piedmont Social House is owned and operated by New Forum in Charlotte.

## Services
- Bowling: 12 bowling lanes, plus pool tables, ping pong and shuffleboard for a night out with friends.
- Billiards, ping pong, darts and cornhole: Billiards tables, ping pong tables, darts, shuffleboard and cornhole to challenge your friends.
- Southern inspired cuisine, craft beer and cocktails: A full-service restaurant with Southern inspired food and a big selection of craft beer and cocktails.
- Work, birthday and retirement parties: Host your work party, birthday party, retirement party or bridal shower with us.

## FAQ
Q: Can I reserve ahead of time?
A: Yes. You can reserve a table, a bowling lane or an event space.

Q: Can guests under 18 come?
A: Yes. Guests under 18 need to be supervised at all times.

Q: Is there an age limit on Friday and Saturday nights?
A: Yes. After 8 pm on Friday and Saturday nights, we're 21 and up only.

## What customers say
- "We showed up right at dinner time with 45 people. An entire soccer team and parents. Not only did they quickly set up big beautiful tables on their outdoor patio, they also assigned us two servers who were the best we have ever had. Dani and Kati started taking orders immediately and separated all the tabs perfectly between players and parents. Food came out within minutes and everything was accurate. The servers stayed on top of drinks and dips and any needs that we had from start to finish. They were such a pleasure. Going out with big groups and sports teams can really be a challenge and this restaurant stepped up in a big way!" (Nadja Young, 5/5)
- "We found this place on a quick weekend trip to Charlotte. It has a very fun atmosphere. We stayed outside, but it seemed like everyone was having a great time indoors. The menu is small, but everything was absolutely delicious. Started off with the southwest egg rolls and they were probably the best I’ve had in awhile. We also tried out the chicken and waffle and steak tacos. The person next to us got the mozzarella sticks which also looked amazing. I ordered fried cheesecake to go which also didn’t disappoint!" (Amber Rierson, 5/5)
- "I was there with my friend last night and I got the wings with fries, and Red Oak beer suggested by our server to go with the wings. The hostess was great, the server was phenonenal. I wasn't super fond of the girl who asked me if I had seen the hostess when I asked if we could sit in the semi-outside part by the bar. She was just slightly less than friendly in the way she asked and that's the only reason I took one star off, but I really can't say enough about the server. He even suggested sitting at the table under the heater (which we did) and we had a great time. I have been there a couple times before (with groups) and it was fine, but this server was really the greatest. The wings and fries were also good." (Carol Canfield, 4/5)
- "This venue was the perfect place for team dinner. The staff was friendly and accommodating to our team. We had nice buffet with selection of garlic shrimp, stuffed mushroom caps, chicken skewers, Mac n cheese balls, spinach and artichoke dip with chips. Also sweet treats were chocolate chip cookies and chocolate cake. Overall we had a great time and I would definitely recommend this venue for team events or just to hangout with family and friends."
